issues.quote: I thought he had dropped something, or that he was showing somebody the piece.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no indication that anyone else was in the atelier at 10:18; it only says a thump occurred there and the repeater sounded.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 'showing somebody the piece' as a hint that another person was with the uncle in the atelier at about 10:18, which is a whereabouts detail the fact sheet does not supply.

issues.quote: It has run badly for ten years.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no duration for the watch's poor running and does not say how far it is off; it only gives the 8:40 reading against the bell at nine.
issues.misreading: The ten-year figure is an extra duration not in the sheet and could lead a solver to assume a fixed, known error for the watch.

issues.quote: Four years on one watch, and he meant it to strike the first minute of the new century.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no duration for the repeater's making.
issues.misreading: The 'four years' figure is an extra duration unrelated to the night's clock readings; it is not a fact the solver is meant to have.
